summary: Concentrated: 21 holdings, but the top ten are 84% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 69% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 1.6 years.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 3 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Starboard Value was founded in 2002 by Jeff Smith and Mark Mitchell inside Ramius Capital, and became independent in 2011.
profile.approach: Buys stakes in underperforming companies and pushes for better margins, sales of businesses, or new management, sometimes replacing whole boards.
known: Darden Restaurants (2014): replaced the entire board with a stake below 10%; the shares rose almost 60% afterwards.
Returned 15.5% a year from 2002 to 2014, with 84% of campaigns profitable.
